def largest_rects(g):
    # find solid uniform rectangles in grid; keep size>=6 (exclude singles)
    res=[]
    h=len(g);w=len(g[0])
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v==8: continue  # skip bg-ish
            # max width run of same color starting at (i,j) and below
            best=[]
            for hh in range(1,h-i+1):
                cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==v for r in range(i,i+hh))]
                # contiguous runs of columns covered
                if not cols: break
                runs=[];cur=[cols[0]]
                for c in cols[1:]:
                    if cur[-1]+1==c: cur.append(c)
                    else: runs.append(cur);cur=[c]
                runs.append(cur)
                best.append((len(runs),hh))
            wts=[b[0]*b[1] for b in best if len(b)>1]
            wts.sort(reverse=True)
            if wts and wts[0]>6:
                # take the top rectangle
                k=best.index(max(best,key=lambda b:b[0]*b[1]))
                L,H=best[k]; cw=max(range(H+1)) if False else [x for x in sorted({y for _ ,y in []})][:0]
                cols_set={c for c in range(w)}
                # get actual column range from the run with most columns
                top = best[max(range(len(best)),key=lambda k: best[k][0]*best[k][1])]
                bestcol=max(cols,key=lambda c: sum(1 for r in range(i,i+top[1]) if g[r][c]==v))
                cells=[(r,c) for r in range(i,i+top[1]) for c in range(bestcol,top[1]+bestcol)]
                res.append({'v':v,'cells':cells})
    return res
